title: The Valmorin Wine Store
flavorText: They celebrated the end of the harvest until two. By six, the owner lay on the catwalk.
tagline: The first-press vintage came out well. That's about the only thing everyone agrees on.
intro: Last night of the harvest at the Valmorin estate, Côtes de Blaye. Edmond Valmorin is found on the vat-room catwalk, above a vat still warm. Three people had keys to the building.

roles.blanche: his daughter-in-law, runs the estate's books

voices.blanche: We finished tasting together, like always. I don't like walking back alone on harvest night.
voices.raymond: I saw him climb up onto the catwalk. I didn't see him come back down.
voices.lucie: I don't know the place yet. I stay where there's light and something green — it settles me.
